notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 regional interaction services to the exact official C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It verifies regional declaration state, committed region context, active/passive per-(interaction-class, region) state, overlap-filtered no-time interaction sends, callback rechecks, and the official RegionHandleSet callback marker. The focused filesystem-report case additionally verifies the successful §9.10/§9.11 file records with type-27 InteractionClassHandle, type-43 RegionHandleSet, and the type-6 passive-indicator Boolean, including stable serial order and switch gating. A paired HLA_IMMEDIATE case now decodes the accepted regional subscription/unsubscription records through HLAreportServiceInvocation, including passive-indicator inversion and serials zero through two. The accepted ordinary regional Send Interaction With Regions companion now verifies the successful type-27/type-40/type-43/type-63/type-34 record through both the configured filesystem and HLA_IMMEDIATE service-report routes before the constrained application callback. The ordinary regional Send Interaction With Regions failure companion now exercises invalid interaction-class, parameter, and region inputs through both the configured filesystem and HLA_IMMEDIATE service-report routes, preserving the type-27/type-40/type-43/type-63/type-34 forms and no application callback. The direct-source Relaxed DDM case additionally proves the documented exact-boundary overlap expansion; broader policy matrices remain open. A passive regional subscription remains declaration and region-lifecycle state but cannot arrange a Receive Interaction callback; re-subscribing the same pair changes its active/passive mode. It does not claim object-instance regional registration/association, object-class attribute regional services, Request Attribute Value Update With Regions, timestamped/retraction behavior, save/restore, remote transport, package support, catalog evidence, or conformance.
